metric: trackScore = 1 - abs(actual - expected) / abs(expected). A zero expected scores 1 only when abs(actual) < 0.05.
tool: tests/visitors.test.ts, 30 Hz, flat walkable ground, seed 3. Same run as npx tsx --test tests/visitors.test.ts.

calibration.knownMatch: sated visitor, no wolf, no berries, no thirst: z = 0, score 1, posture rest
calibration.knownMismatch: legacy sway sin(time * 0.7 + seed) * 0.07 over 4 s peaks at 0.070 rad. Scoring that peak as a heading range against 0.14 rad (the old peak-to-peak) gives 0.000, which fails 0.95.

pixels: not captured. The measured quantity is the body path and the facing, not a picture.
